name: Access Request Reassignment
description: Sent to a reviewer when they have had access requests reassigned to them.
subject: Access request for ${requesterName} is ready for review
body:
Access Request Reassigned for Your Review

Dear ${newOwnerName},

${previousOwnerName} has reassigned ${requesterName}'s access request for the ${requestedObjectName} #if(${requestedObjectType}=="Role") role #elseif(${requestedObjectType}=="Entitlement") entitlement #{else} access profile #{end} to you.

#if($commentText)

${previousOwnerName} provided the following reason for reassignment:

${commentText}

#{end} #if($startDate)

The start date for ${requestedObjectName} is ${startDate}.

#{end} #if($removeDate)

The end date for ${requestedObjectName} is ${removeDate}.

#{end} #if($requestedObjectType=="Role") #if($accessibleItems && $accessibleItems.size() > 0)

If you approve this request, the user will receive access to the following:

    #foreach($item in $accessibleItems)
  • $item
    • #{end}
#{end} #elseif($requestedObjectType=="AccessProfile")

If you approve this request, ${requesterName} will receive access to all entitlements in ${accessProfileName}.

#{end}

Thank you,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
